report.title: Bill Pay refuses mismatched account numbers
report.summary: The Bill Pay page refuses to send a payment request when the account numbers do not match. However, it still allows the user to submit the form.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Log in to the ParaBank website.
2. Go to the Bill Pay page.
3. Enter a payment request with mismatched account numbers.
report.expected: The form should be rejected and an error message should be displayed.
report.actual: The form was submitted and a payment request was sent.
evidence: The account numbers do not match.
a rejected form sent a payment request: ['http://localhost:8080/parabank/services_proxy/bank/billpay?accountId=0&amount=1']
report.suspected_cause: The Bill Pay page's validation logic is not correctly implemented.
report.next_action: The development team should review the Bill Pay page's validation logic and fix the issue.
